about: Conformance vectors of the ProtoDB storage format; see tests/conformance/README.md and docs/source/format-spec.rst.

values.note: NaN: storable as a value, not as a key
@dec: the exact text, trailing zeros kept
@dec: adjusted exponent below -6 gives the exponent form
@dec: adjusted exponent -6 keeps the plain form
@dec: a positive exponent always gives the exponent form
@dec: a signed NaN with a payload
@time in an IANA zone: the wall clock (orders as the naive time, rank 7)
@dt, fixed offset whose name is the default one
@dt, fixed offset with its own name
@dt, IANA zone: the UTC instant (09:00 in Buenos Aires)
@dt, IANA zone: the instant of the second 01:30 of a DST transition (fold 1 in New York)
@ref to a built-in type: tag 21, offset beyond 32 bits
@ref to an application type: tag is the name

values_decode_only.note: format 2 @ref: segment as 32 hexadecimal digits, type as its name
a built-in type spelled by name instead of its alias
an application type spelled by an alias (__type_aliases__): read as the declared name
format 3 zone datetime: the wall clock and fold, resolved with the reader's tz database; written back as the instant
a float 32: read, written as float 64
an integer in a wider encoding than needed

invalid.note: a map value must have exactly one key
a map value must have exactly one key
msgpack ext types are never values
@int of an integer in the native range
a time zone key the reader does not know
the instant form is for @dt only
@sym is reserved (runtime decision of 2026-11-08) and not implemented by this revision
two aware datetimes of one instant conflict
two NaNs with one encoding conflict
a list cannot be a map key
a signaling NaN cannot be a map key
a datetime in an IANA zone cannot be a map key
a root record of an unknown version
a segment of an unknown version
a type tag that is neither an integer nor a string
a record of another type than the reference's
a List without its required count
an attribute named like behaviour of DBObject
an attribute name that is not a string
a log of another format version
a SEGS log opened as ROOT
a damaged frame followed by a valid one: mid-log corruption, never a torn tail
a kind-6 entry with an undefined flag bit
a kind-6 range with start > end
two different roots with one (label, epoch)
a field of the wrong type
a body that is not a map

atom_tokens.value: the list [1, atom] holding a map {"k": atom}

root_v2.note: a format-2 root record is read as a current one

root_v3.note: a format-3 root record is read as a current one

roots_log_torn.note: the last frame cut in its middle: a torn tail, dropped; every earlier entry is read (compare invalid/log-mid-corruption: damaged bytes followed by a valid frame)
